name: Jabin
overview: The name Jabin refers to two kings of Hazor, notable in the biblical narrative for their leadership in opposition to Israel. In Joshua 11, Jabin king of Hazor is depicted as a central figure who rallied a coalition of northern kings and various Canaanite peoples to fight against Israel. Despite the formidable alliance and their numerous horses and chariots, the LORD assured Joshua of victory, promising to deliver these kings into Israel's hands and to destroy their military power. This account highlights God's sovereign protection over His people and His power to overcome even the most daunting enemies.
